name: Golf Towel
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality premium waffle fabric with soft microfiber material, offering excellent absorbency and a lightweight feel.
    - Designed to help clean golf balls, clubs, and hands while staying soft and gentle on surfaces.
    - Features delicate stitched edges for a neat finish and improved durability during regular use.
    - Includes a metal grommet and carabiner clip for easy attachment to golf bags, carts, or belt loops.
    - Lightweight, practical, and easy to carry for everyday golf use.
    - Available with 2 edge binding styles: 
                    +) White Edge Binding
                    +) Black Edge Binding
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Towel size: 40 x 60 cm ~ 15.74 x 23.62 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design. Size may vary by ±, which is considered normal.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using Sublimation Printing technology for vibrant colors, sharp details, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports single-side or double-sided printing depending on your design.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a golf towel and a personalized sports accessory.
    - Designed for wiping clubs, golf balls, hands, and small equipment during play.
    - The carabiner clip allows quick and secure attachment to golf bags for convenient access.
    - Suitable for golf practice, tournaments, casual rounds, and everyday use on the course.
    - Lightweight and easy to carry without adding bulk to your golf gear.
    - Perfect for combining utility with a custom, stylish touch.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for dads, husbands, boyfriends, golf teammates, coaches, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, holidays, golf tournaments, team gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves golf and personalized sports accessories.
    - Great for golfers who want a practical item with a unique personal design.
    - A useful and memorable gift that combines everyday function with custom style.
    - Adds a sporty, personal, and thoughtful touch to any golf setup 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Golf Towel

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
